Name: Shop Portrait Overhaul Framework
Author: SerDakota
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod does nothing on its own and must be used with portrait packs. I have included an article on how to convert/create one. Without any portraits this mod does nothing. With portrait packs it replaces the vanilla shop with new larger portraits. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Removes and replaced the Vanilla shop interface. The shopping menu itself is the same however now a full sized portrait will be displayed.[/color]
It will scale your portraits to a standard size and allow you fine tune the size and position in the GMCM. [/size]

The GMCM allows you to mix and match various shop portraits between all packs installed and vanilla. In addition it has a entry for every shop menu I could find in game (excluding catalogs) allowing you to have unique portraits for each of them. It also includes the ability to assign portraits to shops that normally have no portraits like the Hat Mouse or Joja shop. 

It now supports animations as well.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size]
Content Patcher
Portrait Packs for shops setup to use this framework. Documents provided in Articles on how to do so.
